During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Bimmiel asteroid field|asteroid field]] in the [[MZX33291 system|Bimmiel system]] when a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] set up a minefield in order to divide Imperial forces in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron was then sent by [[Imperial Fleet Command]] to destroy both the minefield and Republic forces in the area.

==The battle==
Using the asteroids above [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]] for cover, the Empire's Fury squadron eliminated one of the defending [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] early on, before whitling down the pursuing enemy [[starfighter]]s and destroying minefield clusters along the way. The slower [[ML-39 Brute Patrol Ship]], which served the Republic as its primary minelayer, was destroyed next. On the other side of the minefield another Republic frigate awaited the Empire's Fury squadron but was crippled and destroyed like its sistership had been earlier. Lastly, when Republic opposition had dwindled, the Empire's Fury targeted the central [[Satellite/Legends|control satellite]], destroying it and completing its mission before jumping to hyperspace.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears as the Kanz Minefield space mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
